fields.description: How this component is treated for statutory purposes. Non-Taxable Payment is cash that is not income - a refund of money wrongly deducted, or a reimbursement - so it is left out of the base entirely.
Tick if this benefit isn't taxed, like medical cover. Leave it off for ones that are, like a company car or housing.
